name: tree-sitter-tcsh
description: Tree-sitter grammar for documented tcsh/csh surface syntax.

scripts.check:no-error: node scripts/check-no-error.js examples/sample.tcsh examples/showcase.tcsh examples/p2-boundaries.tcsh examples/heredoc.tcsh examples/p4-substitutions.tcsh examples/p5-statements.tcsh
scripts.check: npm run generate && npm test && npm run check:coverage-matrix && npm run check:node-contract && npm run check:no-error && npm run check:queries && npm run check:query-captures && npm run check:scanner && npm run check:c-compile && npm run check:recovery
scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm run check:stress && npm run check:package && npm run check:coverage-matrix:release
scripts.check:queries: npm exec -- tree-sitter query --grammar-path . --quiet queries/highlights.scm examples/sample.tcsh && npm exec -- tree-sitter query --grammar-path . --quiet queries/locals.scm examples/sample.tcsh && npm exec -- tree-sitter query --grammar-path . --quiet queries/tags.scm examples/sample.tcsh && npm exec -- tree-sitter query --grammar-path . --quiet queries/folds.scm examples/sample.tcsh
